notes: Named three times in this paragraph: the previously known amorphous tembotrione that the two forms improve on, the tembotrione a formulation contains in form A or form C, and the total quantity of tembotrione the wt. % definition is based on. One record, merged. The printed spelling is identical to the identifier, so there is no alias. No new physical form is asserted for tembotrione itself here: the discrete crystals or crystallites belong to the two form records.

This is form A, according to the invention. It is the same molecule as tembotrione, C17H16ClF3O6S, differing only in the packing of the crystal lattice; it is not a distinct chemical entity and it has the same structure and the same SMILES as tembotrione. It is given its own identifier because the patent names it as a thing and the whole disclosure is about the differences between the forms. compound_class is active_ingredient, the single value used for the whole tembotrione family in this run. commercially_available is false: this form is what the patent discloses. The advantages the section states for it are easier handling than the amorphous form and increased stability against conversion into another modification, both compared with mixtures of the forms. physical_form is crystals and appearance is the printed discrete crystals or crystallites, which the section attributes to the crystal forms A and C during production. The printed names in this section are crystal forms A and C, the pure form A and form A; only form A is carried as an alias because it is the printed string that names the substance. The section defines the term pure form A and pure form C to mean a proportion of the modification in question, of the total tembotrione, of at least 90 wt. % and in particular at least 95 wt. %. That is a definition of a term and not a measured purity of any sample, so purity_pct is left null rather than being filled from it.
